//: Playwright-only tsconfig (used via the --tsconfig flag in package.json). Self-contained path aliases with no astro/tsconfigs/base extends: Playwright 1.62's config loader can't resolve that package specifier when astro is hoisted to the workspace-root node_modules, which aborts the run before any test executes. Playwright only needs these aliases; the shared tsconfig.json stays untouched for astro/editors.
